chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch 151: The Hundred Herbs Garden
chapter_meta_description: Han Li takes control of the Hundred Herbs Garden, burying the mysterious vial in its soil. Cheated on his payment by Hall Master Ye, he quietly accepts the loss and bides his time, laying the true foundation for his cultivation path.
og_title: Chapter 151 Summary: The Hundred Herbs Garden
og_description: A grumpy old man, a secret garden, and a quiet confirmation of Han Li's "never lift a finger without benefit" principle.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch 151: Han Li’s new job is a sleepy herb garden. He loves it—for very different reasons.
twitter_description: Han Li takes over the Hundred Herbs Garden and immediately buries his secret trump card in the soil. He may have lost the battle for the token, but he’s already winning the long game.
